description: Every number in an AI answer traces back to the rows that produced it.
name: com.brick-byte/footnote

environmentVariables.description: Postgres connection string. Omit to use the built-in SQLite sample database.
environmentVariables.name: DATABASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Path to the SQLite provenance log. Defaults to in-memory, which discards the trail on exit.
environmentVariables.name: PROVENANCE_DB

environmentVariables.description: Identity recorded against each provenance record. In production this comes from the request's auth.
environmentVariables.name: PROVENANCE_ACTOR
